scripts.build:safe: node -e "const net=require('net');const s=net.createConnection({port:3000},()=>{console.error('\n❌ ABORT: Port 3000 is in use. Stop dev server before building.\n');s.destroy();process.exit(1)});s.on('error',()=>{s.destroy();require('child_process').execSync('npx next build',{stdio:'inherit'})})"
scripts.clean:next: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=require('path').join(__dirname,'.next');if(fs.existsSync(p)){fs.rmSync(p,{recursive:true,force:true});console.log('✅ .next/ deleted successfully')}else{console.log('ℹ️  .next/ does not exist')}"
scripts.dev:clean: npm run clean:next && npm run dev
